qualification.details: Project Research Scientist I - Medical: MBBS degree from a recognized University. Senior Research Fellow (Ayurveda): Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (BAMS) degree from a recognized university/institute. Project Technical support -1 (Lab Technician): 10th pass with Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT/MLT) from a recognized institution with two years of work experience OR Three-year Graduate degree in B.Sc MLT from a recognized university with one year of work experience. Project Nurse- III: B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized university with three years of work experience and valid registration with any State Nursing Council OR M.Sc. Nursing from a recognized university with valid registration. Project Technical Support III (MSW): Three-year Graduate degree in Social Work or Sociology from a recognized university with three years of work experience OR Postgraduate degree in Social Work or Sociology from a recognized university.

salary_details.details: Project Research Scientist I - Medical: Rs 67000 + 10% HRA Per Month Senior Research Fellow (Ayurveda): Rs 42000 + 10% HRA Per Month Project Technical support -1 (Lab Technician): Rs 18000 + 10% HRA Per Month Project Nurse- III: Rs 28000 + 10% HRA Per Month Project Technical Support III (MSW): Rs 28000 + 10% HRA Per Month

Read the official notification carefully before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NEIGRIHMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.neigrihms.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 19-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application form for the NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026 is 19th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are spread across various posts including Project Research Scientist I - Medical, Senior Research Fellow, Project Technical Support, and Project Nurse.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to the NEIGRIHMS posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026 is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided to eligible candidates as per the government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026 will primarily involve Document Verification followed by an Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages to be considered for the positions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist I - Medical post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Research Scientist I - Medical post will receive a monthly salary of Rs 67000 plus 10% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. Which educational qualifications are required for the Project Technical Support -1 (Lab Technician) post?
faq.answer: For the Project Technical Support -1 (Lab Technician) post, candidates need a 10th pass with a Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT/MLT) and two years of experience, or a B.Sc MLT degree with one year of experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is the application process for NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026 online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process for the NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF for NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the PDF thoroughly before applying.
